source.title: Sugarcane Biorefinery Complex in Thailand and a Proposed Method to Cope with Apportioning Its Environmental Burdens to Co-products
source.rights_note: Copyright notice is present in the PDF; do not redistribute the source file or extracted table pending rights review.

study_scope.functional_flow: LCI flows for production derived from 1 tonne of sugarcane
study_scope.geography: One real site in northeast Thailand; site identity is not stated in this review
study_scope.reported_context: Milling normally occurs December-March; the season used for the collected data is not dated
study_scope.locator: Section 3.1 / PDF page 2 / printed page 97; Table 1 / PDF page 4 / printed page 98

reported_balance_rechecks.name: bagasse transfer
reported_balance_rechecks.equation: 340.0 kg sugar-mill output = 340.0 kg power-plant input

reported_balance_rechecks.name: molasses transfer
reported_balance_rechecks.equation: 42.1 kg sugar-mill output = 42.1 kg ethanol-factory input

reported_balance_rechecks.name: filter-cake transfer
reported_balance_rechecks.equation: 45.3 kg sugar-mill output = 45.3 kg fertilizer-factory input

reported_balance_rechecks.name: steam distribution
reported_balance_rechecks.equation: 617.3 kg generated = 582.3 kg to sugar mill + 28.2 kg to ethanol factory + 6.8 kg waste steam

reported_balance_rechecks.name: net electricity distribution
reported_balance_rechecks.equation: 107.4 kWh net output = 31.8 kWh sugar mill + 0.9 kWh ethanol factory + 0.2 kWh fertilizer factory + 73.5 kWh sold + 1.0 kWh pipeline transportation

methane_method_reference.source_remark: CH4 and N2O emissions only; CO2 not included
methane_method_reference.reason: No matched TSM/DEDE BOD load, same-period methane release, capture/slip, or compatible treatment-boundary record is established. This factor is not a methane mass emission factor.

cross_publication_methane_trace.cited_reference_locator: JSEE 2014 reference [42] / PDF page 8 / printed page 103
cross_publication_methane_trace.methane_parameter_locator: 2008 paper Table 3 / PDF page 5 / printed page 305

comparison_to_2014_factor.reason: A source-verified GWP characterization factor and gas-by-gas derivation were not found in the reviewed pages; the 2014 table explicitly includes CH4 and N2O and excludes CO2. Do not derive or assign the combined factor from the CH4 parameter alone.

reported_wastewater_quality_flag.source_row: Ethanol-factory wastewater reports BOD 7.8E-10 kg and volume 1.5E-2 L
reported_wastewater_quality_flag.interpretation: Value is transcribed as printed and visually checked. The unusually low implied concentration is a review flag, not evidence that the source is wrong; do not correct, substitute, or use it in the project methane model without independent clarification.

allocation_and_boundary_notes.allocation_methods_reported: economic, energy, and exergy allocation; Scheme-a and sequential Scheme-b
allocation_and_boundary_notes.table_4_5_arithmetic_review: Existing 33-cell allocation arithmetic review remains in docs/ethanol-whole-cycle-reference.md; no new allocation factor applied to TSM/DEDE
allocation_and_boundary_notes.double_counting_warning: Electricity/steam generated by the power plant are internal coproduct flows before external sale; choose one study boundary and avoid counting internal transfers as both delivered inputs and additional final outputs.
